headline: Team India Guaranty issues notice for postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: Team India Guaranty Limited has formally informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot. The filing initiates the voting process for resolutions requiring shareholder approval without holding a physical general meeting. As a routine corporate governance filing, it sets off the designated voting window for registered investors. Retail shareholders holding the stock should review the ballot details to exercise their voting rights on the proposed corporate matters.
why_it_matters: Review the ballot notice to vote on upcoming corporate resolutions.

headline: Team India Guaranty clarifies director resignation filing
hook: Procedural update from a small-cap entity
summary: Team India Guaranty has submitted a formal clarification regarding a recent director resignation. The filing provides routine corporate governance updates to exchange records. For an Indian retail investor, this micro-cap procedural filing has negligible bearing on broader market trends or portfolio performance.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for retail portfolios
